title: SourceConfig
description: Configures a materialized leandir and the language transformations used to create and update it.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors.

leandir.description: Leandir path, resolved relative to this config file's directory.

languages.description: Enabled language domains and their settings. An empty object copies every file unchanged.

ignore.description: Gitignore-compatible rules applied after ignoreFile rules. Paths are source-root-relative and use forward slashes.

ignoreFile.description: One or more gitignore-compatible files. Relative paths are resolved from this config file; files are loaded in array order.

humanFormatter.description: Formatter used only when pulling supported AI-edited source with sync. Lean source is sent on stdin and human source must be returned on stdout. The process runs in the source root with shell:false; every {file} argument placeholder is replaced by the absolute destination filename. Spawn errors, nonzero exits, invalid output, and stderr on failure abort sync before ordinary source writes.

command.description: Executable name or path; it is invoked directly with shell:false.

args.description: Arguments passed directly to the formatter. Use {file} where the formatter needs the destination path.
